children: The British arm of German discounter Aldi said on Monday it will invest £900 million ($1.2 billion) next year, including in 40 new stores and its distribution network, as it seeks to grow its market share.
The group, owned by Germany's Aldi Sud, currently trades from 1,092 stores and plans to open 30 over the next 10 weeks. Its long-term target is 1,500 stores.
